hypothesis: Published numbers show agentic deep research beats the strongest non-agentic single model by a large margin on BrowseComp and HLE; and Anthropic's multi-agent gain coincides with a several-fold token increase
result: BrowseComp: Deep Research 5.2x o1 (+41.6 pts), 27x GPT-4o w/ browsing; HLE: 2.05x o3-mini-high (+13.6 pts). Anthropic: multi-agent uses ~3.75x the tokens of a single agent (15x vs 4x of chat) for a reported 1.90x eval gain - gains not compute-matched.
